name: Baklava
steps: Boil sugar, water and lemon juice for 8 minutes; set aside to cool. Chop nuts finely and mix with cinnamon.
Heat oven to 170°C. Trim filo to a small tin and keep unused sheets covered with a barely damp cloth.
Layer butter-brushed filo in the tin, spreading nuts between groups of sheets; finish with several buttered sheets and cut diamonds.
Bake for 40–45 minutes until crisp and golden; pour cooled syrup over hot pastry and rest for 3 hours before serving.
tips: Cut before baking so syrup reaches the lower layers without crushing the pastry.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
